key.name: enabled
key.summary: Whether cell broadcast messages should be displayed
key.description: When this is disabled the shell will not show any cell broadcast messages, including important security warnings.

key.name: auto-brightness-offset
key.summary: Auto brightness offset
key.description: Fixed offset added to the calculated auto brightnes value.

key.name: status-icons
key.summary: List of enabled status-icon plugins
key.description: The list of currently enabled status-icon plugins.

key.name: favorites
key.summary: List of desktop file IDs for favorite applications
key.description: The applications corresponding to these identifiers will be displayed in the favorites panel along with running applications.

key.name: app-filter-mode
key.summary: How to filter apps in the overview. The default 'adaptive' shows only adaptive apps in mobile mode and all apps in docked mode. 'off' turns of all filtering.
key.description: Whether to filter out apps that aren't marked as adaptive in mobile mode.

key.name: force-adaptive
key.summary: List of desktop file IDs for applications that are adaptive for phone usage but not marked as such in their desktop file.
key.description: The applications corresponding to these identifiers will be displayed in the app grid panel even when in mobile mode that only lists touch capable apps that adapt to small screen sizes.

key.name: wwan-backend
key.summary: Which backend to use for interfacing with the cellular modem
key.description: The available backends are 'modemmanager' for ModemManager (the default) and 'ofono' for oFono. This setting is only read when Phosh starts, so a shell restart is required after changing it.

key.name: automatic-high-contrast
key.summary: Whether to switch to HighContrast theme in high brightness conditions
key.description: Setting this to true enables automatic switching to HighContrast on high ambient night levels.

key.name: automatic-high-contrast-threshold
key.summary: The light level (in Lux) to switch to HighContrast theme
key.description: When automatic high contrast is enabled this defines the light level at which to switch.

key.name: enable-suspend
key.summary: Whether to enable suspend from the power menu
key.description: Setting this to true allows manually suspending the device from the power menu. Suspend is an experimental feature on some devices and may result in crashes or instability.

key.name: quick-silent
key.summary: Allow to quickly silence the device
key.description: Setting this to true allows to set the phone to silent by pressing volume-down on incoming calls when the phone is locked. This feature is experimental.

key.name: shell-layout
key.summary: What information to use to layout UI elements.
key.description: This determines if Phosh will use device information to layout UI elements in order to not overlap with notches and cutouts.

key.name: osk-unfold-delay
key.summary: OSK unfold long press delay factor
key.description: Delay factor for long press on the home bar to unfold the keyboard. Valid values are [0.5,2.0]. Values less than 1.0 make the unfold trigger sooner, greater than 1.0 make the unfold trigger later.

key.name: enabled
key.summary: Whether emergency calls are enabled
key.description: When this is disabled the shell will not offer emergency call functionality.

key.name: shuffle-keypad
key.summary: Whether to scramble the keypad
key.description: Setting this to true shuffle the digits on the PIN keypad to make eavesdropping harder.

key.name: require-unlock
key.summary: Require authentication in lockscreen
key.description: Setting this to false allows unlocking without entering the PIN or password by simply swiping up.

key.name: wakeup-screen-triggers
key.summary: What notification properties wake up the screen
key.description: This setting defines what properties of a notification wake up the screen. (e.g. the notification's category or urgency).

key.name: wakeup-screen-categories
key.summary: Notification categories that wake up the screen
key.description: If matching by category is enabled defines which categories will wake up the screen.

key.name: wakeup-screen-urgency
key.summary: Notification urgency that wakes up the screen
key.description: If matching by urgency is enabled sets the lowest notification urgency that wakes up the screen.

key.name: lock-screen
key.summary: List of enabled lockscreen plugins
key.description: The list of currently enabled plugins on the lock screen.

key.name: quick-settings
key.summary: List of enabled quick setting plugins
key.description: The list of currently enabled plugins on the quick settings box.

key.name: config
key.summary: Monitor configuration
key.description:
Configuration for each monitor. The key is the monitor name and the value is a dictionary with the following keys: - 'scale': the scale factor for the monitor - 'x': the x position of the monitor - 'y': the y position of the monitor
NB: rotation is deliberately not stored so that we always start in the default orientation.

key.name: appid
key.summary: Last used application ID
key.description: Stores the application ID of the last app used or referenced by the shell. This can be used to restore session state or remember user preferences related to a specific app.

key.name: filtered-app-ids
key.summary: Hidden applications
key.description: List of application IDs to filter out and hide from the app list. Apps in this list will not appear in the launcher or app drawer.

key.name: glass-theme
key.summary: Use the FuriOS glass theme
key.description: Whether to style the shell as frosted glass. Off leaves phosh with its own stylesheet untouched; on loads the FuriOS variant of it and gives GTK4 applications a matching one. The keys below only take effect while this is on.

key.name: accent-color-custom
key.summary: Custom accent colour
key.description: A free-form accent colour for the shell, as any colour GDK can parse, for example '#3584e4'. When set this overrides the accent chosen in Settings, so the shell is not limited to the nine preset swatches. Empty means follow that setting. Note that GTK4 applications only understand the presets, so a custom colour applies to the shell alone.

key.name: glass-text-color
key.summary: Shell text colour
key.description: A free-form colour for the shell's text and icons, as any colour GDK can parse. Every piece of shell text follows this, including text drawn on an accent fill. Empty follows the theme, which is near-white on the dark variant and near-black on the light one.

key.name: glass-accent-text-color
key.summary: Colour of text drawn on the accent
key.description: The colour of labels and icons sitting on top of an accent fill -- a selected quick setting, a pressed keypad key, a card. This is a different question from the main text colour only if you want it to be. Empty follows the main text colour, so all of the shell's text matches unless this is set deliberately.

key.name: glass-text-shadow-color
key.summary: Colour of the drop shadow behind shell text
key.description: The colour of the small drop shadow carried by the shell's text and icons, most visibly the lock screen clock, date and status labels, which sit over a wallpaper the shell does not choose. Empty follows the text colour in use and takes the opposite of it, so light text gets a dark shadow and dark text a light one. Changing glass-text-color is therefore enough on its own; this key is for the case where the wallpaper wants a shadow that is neither.

key.name: glass-text-shadow
key.summary: Strength of the drop shadow behind shell text
key.description: How opaque that shadow is. 0 turns it off entirely. The offset stays small and fixed -- one to three pixels depending on the size of the text, always more than the blur under it, because a blur wider than its offset is a glow rather than a shadow. It is there to hold text legible against an arbitrary wallpaper, not to be seen in its own right.

key.name: glass-text-opacity
key.summary: Shell text opacity
key.description: How opaque the shell's text and icons are. Lower values let the frosted backdrop show through the text itself. The floor is deliberate: text that can be turned fully invisible is a way to make the shell unusable with no obvious way back.

key.name: lockscreen-tint
key.summary: Tint the wallpaper behind the lock screen clock
key.description:
Whether the lock screen lays its translucent sheet over the wallpaper on the page showing the clock and date. On, the wallpaper is dimmed and the clock stays legible over a bright or busy picture. Off, the picture is shown as it is.
The keypad page keeps its sheet either way: the keys and the passcode entry need a surface to sit on.

key.name: glass-blur-radius
key.summary: Background blur radius
key.description: How strongly the compositor blurs what is behind the shell's glass surfaces: the top panel, the settings drawer and the lock screen. 0 turns the blur off. Needs a compositor that supports background blur; without one this has no effect.

key.name: glass-opacity
key.summary: Glass opacity
key.description: How solid the shell's glass surfaces are. 0.0 is fully transparent and 1.0 is opaque, hiding the blur behind it entirely. Other glass surfaces are scaled from this, keeping their relative weights. Application windows keep a small minimum whatever this is set to, since a window with no background at all leaves its text floating on the wallpaper.

key.name: glass-lightness
key.summary: Glass lightness
key.description: How much white is mixed into the glass, for a frostier and paler look. 0.0 keeps the theme's own background colour.

key.name: glass-accent-wash
key.summary: Accent wash strength
key.description: How much of the accent colour is washed into the glass surfaces, so that the drawer, lock screen and overview carry the accent chosen in Settings. 0.0 leaves them neutral. The light theme uses a lower proportion of this, since a tint reads more strongly against a pale background.
